description: A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV, LG webOS and Samsung Tizen. One button to undo.

latest_release.name: Free My TV 1.3: updates itself, the TMDB key from your phone, Continue Watching
latest_release.body:
Free My TV 1.3: the APK now updates itself, your TMDB key goes from your phone to the TV, the picks get posters and your own Plex library, Continue Watching can take the top of the home screen, and more TVs on every platform.

**Install**
- **Google TV and Android TV:** download `FreeMyTV.apk` below and install it with `adb install -r FreeMyTV.apk` (the README's *The ready APK* has the steps). It updates the 1.2 APK in place, settings included, and from now on *Home Settings* → *Updates* installs the next release, with Android asking first. For the movie and series picks, open *Home Settings* → *TMDB key*. If you built Free My TV yourself before, switch back to *Original* and uninstall it first: the two are signed with different keys. On TCL TVs, run the README's `appops` line again after that uninstall, since it takes TCL's background permission away and the switch can't start without it.
- **Samsung (2017 and newer):** in TizenBrew Installer, *Install from GitHub* → `simbasjungles/free-my-tv`. It takes `FreeMyTV-tizen.wgt` from this release and updates the one you have. On 2015 and 2016 TVs, build it yourself (the README has the steps).
- **LG (webOS 3 and newer):** the webOS Homebrew Channel updates it (repository `https://freemytv.io/webos/apps.json`), or install `FreeMyTV-webos.ipk` through Developer Mode (`python3 webos/install.py <TV's IP>`).

**On every TV**
- **Your TMDB key on the TV.** *Home Settings* → *TMDB key*: on Google TV and Android TV a QR code opens a page on your phone to paste it (it works once, for 5 minutes, only on your home network); on LG and Samsung you type it. Without a key, the Explore, Movies and Shows tabs stay out of the way. (#333 by @Ugoyo, #336 by @BrunoGiacomazzi)
- **Bigger cards, real posters.** The focused card widens and the others show posters, up to six picks per tab, and each tab starts at its first pick. (#133 by @AdvaitT17, #362 by @RahulRex0)
- **Prices:** dollars when Binance halts a currency's pairs (#273 by @donut3226), and euros in Bulgaria (#335 by @viniciusdsandrade). The picks reach TMDB through `api.tmdb.org` where `api.themoviedb.org` is blocked (#327).

**Google TV and Android TV**
- **The APK updates itself:** once a week it looks for a newer release, and *Home Settings* → *Updates* installs it through Android's installer. It only takes this repository's releases, signed with the project's key. (#310 by @halgurdh)
- **Continue Watching:** *Home Settings* → *Top of the screen* picks the recommendations, Continue Watching or the clock. Continue Watching shows what you left half-way, from Android TV's own lists, with its progress, and OK resumes it in its app. (#42 by @ismaelmelgar)
- **Picks from:** choose which services the picks come from, bring your own Plex library in, and the German services join (ARD, ZDF, ARTE, Joyn, RTL+, WOW, MagentaTV). Watchmode skips channels resold inside another app. (#152 and #135 by @AdvaitT17, #314 by @falcobartsch, #266 by @tscole)
- **Now Playing:** what any app is playing, in the quotes' place while it plays, on the home screen and the screensaver. (#287 and #301 by @LeoFeitosa)
- On our home screen the remote's Settings button opens the TV's Settings (#289 by @halgurdh). On the screensaver, OK can open the title in its app (#276 by @halgurdh), and `screensaver=false` keeps the TV's own screensaver (#284 by @EasterwoodBiker).
- **More TVs:** Fire TV's HDMI inputs, Live TV on the antenna and the Appstore in All Apps (#292 by @GiovanniGrillo, #303 by @MLaminekane); Keystone on HY300 projectors (#316 by @fernandoavra); Xiaomi's YouTube and PatchWall buttons in Remote Buttons (#170 by @yudizaxay, #359 by @kshitijcoldplay-blip); on TCL, TCL Channel and its channel source stay on (#352 by @schmidt-gabriel) and the home screen is opaque again (#263 by @werewolfvit); the Hotack X1BR (#342) and Wanbo T2 Ultra (#157) projectors; firmware without the launcherapps service (#337 by @MoazEmad1); OneWorld TV Center's live TV (#296 by @viniciusdsandr

detail.readme_excerpt:
# Free My TV **A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV, LG and Samsung TVs.** Trending picks from your own apps, the weather at a glance, and a look that follows the sunset.
Open source. Built with Claude Code. One button to undo. [**freemytv.io**](https://freemytv.io) · [Install](#install) · [LG TVs](#lg-tvs-webos) · [Samsung TVs](#samsung-tvs-tizen) · [Any TV](#any-tv) · [Make it yours](#make-it-yours)
## What you get - **No ads.** No sponsored rows, banners or autoplaying promos. Not one. - **Your apps, front and center.** The streaming apps you actually use, on a glass shelf. Pick them and their order right on the TV. - **Trending, not sponsored.** Three fresh picks every hour (up to six, in Home Settings) from what's trending this week and the latest releases, only from apps you already have, and from the services you choose. The focused one opens wide and the others show their posters. Movies and Shows get their own tabs, and on Google TV your own [Plex library](#your-plex-library-optional) can join in. - **Continue Watching** (Google TV and Android TV). *Home Settings* → *Top of the screen* puts what you left halfway in your apps on top, with its progress, and OK picks it up in its app. Or a big clock, or the picks. - **Your TMDB key from your phone.** *Home Settings* → *TMDB key* shows a QR code: scan it and paste the key. On LG and Samsung, type it with the remote. - **Weather and markets, one press away.** The hour-by-hour forecast (or the next 5 days), sunrise and sunset, and live crypto prices; on LG and Samsung, also rain in the next two hours, the UV index and the air quality. - **Live TV or your box on HDMI, one press away** (LG and Samsung). *Home Settings* → *Live TV button* picks what the first top button opens: Live TV, as before, or one of the TV's HDMI inputs, shown under the name you gave the input on the TV when it has one. - **What's playing.** Music, a podcast or the radio going on in the background shows on the home screen and the screensaver: the title, the artist and the app, from any app that tells Android what it plays (*Home Settings*, off until you turn it on). - **The status at a glance, and a mouse** (Google TV and Android TV). *Home Settings* → *Status icons* puts Wi-Fi or Ethernet, Bluetooth audio and a USB drive at the top of the home screen; off, nothing listens for them. A mouse or an air-mouse remote works too: hover moves the focus, the wheel scrolls, a click picks. - **Light by day, dark by night.** It follows your city's real sunset, the way your phone does. - **A screensaver to match.** Full-screen photos of the picks with a big glass clock.
